versions.content: If for a dataElement to be received a ReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRange = externalReplacement is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the receiving component. If the value is out of bounds, the value ac- tually received shall be replaced by the value sourced from the ReceiverComSpec . replaceWith (e.g. constant, NVRAM parameter). If the value of the received dataElement is out of bounds and a Nonqueue- dReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRangeStatus = indicate is provided, the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE . In case of a composite datatype the value actually received shall be completely re- placed by the external value, if any of the composite elements is out of bounds. If the handleOutOfRangeStatus attribute is set to indicate , the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE .
